verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents OpenTelemetry-based ingestion (OTLP over gRPC/HTTP, plus Collector for legacy formats) as the core instrumentation path, which covers hosts, containers, and cloud services generically through OTel SDKs/Collector, but there is no explicit mention of vendor-maintained host agents, a dedicated Kubernetes integration/operator, or named cloud-service integrations (e.g., AWS/GCP native connectors) in the evidence pack. missing for 10: dedicated Kubernetes integration/agent, host-level agent, named cloud-provider integrations, independent corroboration of ease/coverage across these environments.
